fields.statement: Verifier at 54110a0ef: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'Watchdog|Classif' passes. With an injected classifier, TestWatchdogTransient retries the transient failures (work, lock, gh) and leaves the real one to the inbox, logging 'classified real' with its reason; TestWatchdogTransientClassifierError leaves both a classifier error and a missing classifier to the inbox, never resuming, and logs the reason. grep finds no transientSignatures in code. Attempt-1 findings fixed: classifyOnce remembers a real or unjudged verdict in WatchdogRun.Judged at the journal's last entry, so a second poll neither classifies nor logs again, and a new failure is judged anew (tested); watchdogRequests now checks budget and queue before classifying and logs real verdicts (TestWatchdogRequests). Memory carries across polls via watchdogPasses for non-live runs. go vet and gofmt clean; internal/daemon tests pass.
